race.description: Apg Super Series 2yo Trotting C&G Fnl (G1)
race.comment: A back row draws presents a challenge to unbeaten gelding VERBICI (9) but it is impossible to knock what he has done so far. Stretched his perfect record to six when leading to get home by 3m in last week's heat. He'll enjoy a nice trail early and with even luck he can rely on class to get him home again. INSULATOR (5) overcame a break to win his heat here last week. He draws wider but is peaking at the right time. With manners he could strike again. A wide draw hasn't made life any easier for REGAL GALA (7) but he is a consistent colt who chased VERBICI as runner-up in his last two outings here. He can be in the finish again. Last week's placegetter DANCE DANCE DANCE (10) is a first-four hope.
